<@&1417820113981145228> we are planning to make the consensus-specs v1.7.0-alpha.14 release today (starting the action in an hour or two, after we merge a couple minor things). There are two key changes in this release that clients should try to add to `glamsterdam-devnet-8` branches *before* the Gloas upgrade in devnet-8. Those PRs are:
* Add gas limit schedule (EIP-8261) ([#5533](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5533))
* Set the slot of the upgraded execution payload bid ([#5550](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5550))
